subject: R session aborts with stan sampling

messages.author: abab84dd2ba42997
messages.subject: R session aborts with stan sampling
parts:
Hi everyone,

I'm trying to sample the attached model from the attached data. As you'll notice from the commented lines calculating prob[n], I'm testing a few different functions to link the quantity delta_r to a probability of success in a bernoulli variable. I've been having troubles with this fitting ("error: no step size small enough, perhaps your posterior is not continuous?"), so wanted to take a look at the gradients.

I run stan with the test_grad = TRUE flag, and more often than not, my whole R session terminates. Can anyone reproduce this error?

Thanks for your time

Tom
